summary: Proposed zn is an indexing label for a foreign formula, not an established Turoyo root. The attested words are Kurdish Xude zane, immediately followed by a Turoyo assertion; the code switch ends at the formula.

No Turoyo stem, Preterit/Infectum base pair or numbered verbal sense is proposed. The only attested form is Kurdish zane in this fixed phrase. Assigning it to I Infectum would misrepresent the available evidence.

The Kurdish formula functions as an asseveration, translated Weiß Gott by the edition. Its know meaning belongs to the foreign expression; it does not demonstrate a productive Turoyo experiencer construction.
Permitted lookup confirms no zn entry and no Xude zane hit. Preserve this single occurrence for editorial decisions about loan formulas, without inventing an etymology or treating it as a light verb.
